resources.string: Messages arrive on your target devices, securely encrypted all the way.
Pin Glide keeps no SMS or OTP forwarding history and never uploads plaintext to the Pin Glide service.

SMS content and OTPs stay in memory only during processing and are released on completion or failure. When OTP extraction is needed, this device sends the SMS directly to the Bailian model service. The original SMS is still encrypted and forwarded if extraction fails.

Only the paired clients hold Pairing keys. Android Keystore protects the local copies and model credentials. They never enter logs or URLs, and Pairing keys are never uploaded to the Pin Glide service. Model credentials are used only to authenticate to the model service.
The Pin Glide service routes ciphertext only
This device encrypts the SMS and OTP independently for each target device. The Pin Glide service cannot read the plaintext or client encryption keys.
Diagnostics contain only non-content metadata such as time, result category, status code, request ID and target count. They never record SMS content, OTPs, ciphertext, credentials or keys.

Local identity, credentials and Pairing keys are excluded from cloud backups and device transfers. Uninstalling or clearing app data loses them. Sign in and pair your target devices again; backups cannot restore them.
Allow Pin Glide to read new incoming SMS messages.
Allow SMS permission in system settings to continue. Forwarding stays paused while permission is off.
Android may not show the permission dialog again. You may need to allow access in application settings.
SMS permission is still off. Allow SMS permission in application settings.
We recommend finding Pin Glide in system settings and turning off battery optimization. Each new SMS starts only a brief processing task, which stops immediately on completion or failure.
Unable to open system settings. Find Pin Glide in your device settings, then try again.
Sign in with QQ to manage devices and authorize encrypted forwarding.

By signing in, you authorize QQ Connect (Tencent) to use your device model and QQ/TIM installation information for authorization. Pin Glide sends a fresh one-use code to its service; QQ provider credentials stay with the service.
QQ authorization was cancelled or sign-in could not be confirmed. Try signing in again.
The saved identity could not be opened or saved safely. Existing data is preserved. Check again; do not clear app data to retry.
Open Pin Glide on the target device and display its QR code, then scan and confirm it. This device can then start forwarding SMS.
Open Pin Glide on the target device and display its QR code, then scan it with this device.
Device list. Pull down or press Enter to refresh.
New SMS messages will be encrypted and forwarded to the selected devices. This app does not read your SMS history.
Add your first device to start forwarding new SMS messages.
Turn on receiving for at least one device to forward new SMS messages.
Selected devices must be online to receive new SMS messages. Messages received while offline will not be replayed.
Getting your devices and Pairings from the service.
Check your connection. The list refreshes when you return to the app.
Pull down or use the Refresh device list accessibility action to retry. This does not mean your Pairings were deleted or your login expired.
The network or service is temporarily unavailable. Check your connection and pull down to retry.
Existing Pairings are retained. Device presence is currently unconfirmed.
SMS permission is off. New messages cannot enter processing.
Allow SMS permission to resume forwarding when its other requirements are met. Existing Pairings are retained.
Open Pin Glide application settings manually and allow SMS permission.
SMS permission is on. Forwarding has resumed.
Your credentials cannot be renewed. Signing in with the original QQ account preserves this Sender’s Pairings.
This Sender registration is permanently closed. Forwarding has stopped.
Turning this off keeps this target paired.
The local key is missing or damaged. Forwarding to this target is off. Remove its Pairing, then add the target again. Other targets are unaffected.
Enter a unique target name of 1–40 characters.
This name is visible only to this Sender.
The name contains an invalid character. Enter it again.
Another paired target already has this name. Choose a different name.
This Sender will stop forwarding SMS to this target. The target and its Pairings with other Senders will stay active.
The operation did not complete and receiving is unchanged. Wait for the current operation to finish and retry.
The saved name is unconfirmed. Your input is kept. Check your connection and retry; the next refresh will reconcile the result.
Removal is unconfirmed. Check your connection and retry. Forwarding to this target is off and its key is kept; the next refresh will reconcile the result.
This target’s Pairing no longer exists
The Pairing may have been removed or revoked elsewhere. This operation did not continue. Pair again to forward to this target.
This device’s old registration is permanently closed and cannot be restored. Signing in again creates a new registration. You will need to pair your target devices again.
Sign out and sign in again
Please wait. Your existing Pairings will be retained.
QQ authorization was cancelled. Forwarding is still paused. Your Pairings and names are unchanged.
Unable to sign in right now
This Sender could not be restored right now. Your Pairings are retained. Try signing in again later.
This authorization cannot restore the original Sender. Retry with the original QQ account. To switch accounts, return to Settings.
Sign-in restored. Your existing Pairings are retained.
Scan the QR code on your target device
QR codes expire after five minutes. Keep Pin Glide open on the target device.
Choose a name you can recognize for this target device.
Device name confirmed. This device is not connected yet.
This is not a valid Pin Glide Pairing QR code. Keep scanning.
This QR code expired or was already used. Generate a new one on the target device.
This Pairing mode is not supported. Use an add-device QR code.

Unable to validate the session. Check your connection and scan again. Existing Pairings are unchanged.

Camera permission is blocked. Enable it in system settings.
Unable to open settings. Open system settings manually to enable the camera.
Pin Glide needs battery optimization turned off to keep working
Revocation requires verification with the current QQ account. The selected Sender’s registration and Pairings will be permanently removed. Other Senders are unaffected.
Pin Glide will immediately stop forwarding on this device and try to revoke its service credentials. Device Pairings and local Pairing keys will be kept.
Forwarding has stopped, but the logout state could not be saved. Retry before closing the app.
Could not restore the original Sender. Retry, or verify your QQ account again to register a new Sender. Existing Pairing keys are kept until the new login succeeds.
Register a Sender with fresh QQ authorization
Could not get the device list. Check your connection and try again.
This permanently closes this Sender’s old registration and removes all its Pairings. To use it again, sign in and pair again on that device. Other Senders are unaffected.
You confirmed revoking “%1$s”. Verify the QQ Account currently signed in. Successful verification immediately submits the revocation.
QQ verification was cancelled. Revocation has not been submitted. Verify again or return to device access management.
QQ verification did not complete. The selected device was not revoked. Please try again.
Verify with the QQ Account currently signed in. The selected device was not revoked and your Account has not changed.
Revocation of “%1$s” could not be confirmed. Return to device access management to view the latest list.
This Sender’s old registration is closed and all its Pairings are removed. To use it again, sign in and pair again on that device.
